name: @adatechnology/interactables-test-area
description: Furniture and interactive objects area for the shared destruction test room: a TestableModule with one destructible item per household type, animations, fluids and scenarios. The page also carries the weapons module (with accessories) to shoot, burn and blow the furniture up with real weapons, and the items module: the containers of the furniture (fridge, cabinets, wardrobe) hold real items from the goods catalog at their real size. It also carries the characters and animals modules: a 7.62 shot crosses a wardrobe door and then the zombie behind it. And the vehicles module: a car stands in the yard next to the furniture and a 7.62 goes through its door while the fridge beside it feels nothing.
